svg.title: Effort control and speed control on a hill
svg.desc: An animation of an XRP, seen from the side, driving over a hill: flat ground, an uphill slope, a flat top and a downhill slope. Two buttons choose how it is controlled. Effort control: the effort gauge stays at the same level the whole way, and the robot crawls up the slope, speeds up on the flat top and goes fastest down the other side; red dots dropped at equal time steps bunch together uphill and spread out downhill. Speed control: the speed gauge stays the same the whole way while the effort gauge climbs high going uphill, drops to medium on the top and falls low going downhill; blue dots are evenly spaced.
svg.text: Same hill, two ways to drive

g.text: so the hill sets the speed
so the hill sets the effort
